description:
Email a booking inquiry to hello@weewilds.com on behalf of a guest.

    Requires an access token (Authorization: Bearer header). Without one this
    tool sends nothing and returns the direct booking URL instead — send the
    guest there, or to hello@weewilds.com.

    Does NOT create an OwnerRez booking directly — the host will reply to the
    guest_email to confirm availability and arrange payment. Rate-limited to
    5 inquiries per hour per client.

    Args:
        unit: One of "muckle-meadow-pod", "cosie-coorie-pod", "bb".
        check_in: Arrival date YYYY-MM-DD.
        check_out: Departure date YYYY-MM-DD, must be after check_in.
        guest_name: Guest's full name.
        guest_email: Valid email — the host replies here.
        guests: Number of guests (1–10).
        notes: Optional special requests (dietary, arrival time, etc.).

check_in.description: Arrival date, YYYY-MM-DD. Must not be in the past.
check_in.title: Check In

check_out.description: Departure date, YYYY-MM-DD. Must be after check_in.
check_out.title: Check Out

guest_email.description: Guest's email address. The host replies here to confirm and arrange payment.
guest_email.title: Guest Email

notes.description: Optional special requests, e.g. dietary needs or arrival time.
notes.title: Notes

unit.description: Which WEE WiLDS unit: "muckle-meadow-pod" (Muckle Meadow Glamping Pod), "cosie-coorie-pod" (Cosy Coorie Pod) or "bb" (the B&B, all 4 rooms).
unit.title: Unit

name: send_inquiry
title: Send booking enquiry
